titleAr: تركيب القوالب الجاهزة تلقائي عند ربط الرقم
titleEn: Starter templates and a Meta sync when a number connects

ar: ليه مفيش قوالب عندي بعد ما ربطت الرقم؟
ازاي تركيب القوالب الجاهزة تلقائي عند ربط الرقم؟
en: Why are there no templates after I connected my number?

steps: When a number connects (or a half-finished connect is resumed): Meta's templates are synced first and adopted, then only the missing starters are submitted; a marker records it is done
edgeCases: A failure never fails the connect: an alert is logged and the Templates screen retries
The shared number's WABA never gets starters
assistantNote: system hook, not callable; if starters are missing offer templates.install-defaults (confirm)
